thesis_text: I think Costco beats on EPS and membership fee growth stays strong, but margins disappoint because of freight costs. I'd put $100 at risk at most.

approved_comparison_rules.EPS above consensus: ABOVE_REFERENCE; human may mark this claim unscored unless a pre-freeze consensus source, value, timestamp, and exact reported/adjusted EPS basis are captured and match the issuer's reported measure.
approved_comparison_rules.membership fee growth stays strong: UP_YEAR_OVER_YEAR; operational proxy is membership-fee income higher than the comparable prior-year period, not a general definition of strong.
approved_comparison_rules.margins disappoint: DOWN_YEAR_OVER_YEAR; operational proxy is the same explicitly sourced gross-margin metric lower than the comparable prior-year period; do not derive or substitute a different margin measure after release.
approved_comparison_rules.because of freight costs: EXPLICIT_ATTRIBUTION as a separate claim; confirm only when the issuer's source text explicitly links freight/shipping/transportation to margin or cost-of-sales impact. A margin decline alone is insufficient.

baseline_method: Use the declared pre-close window ending at 16:00 ET; do not anchor it to the unknown release timestamp.
capture_plan: Capture RCOSTUSDT one-minute market candles and the authenticated raw Reality order book, with exchange and local receipt timestamps, from 15:30 through 20:00 ET on 2026-09-24. Also attempt Reality platform fills if accessible. Capture the public aggregated market order book and generic public SPOT fills only as separately labelled diagnostics; they do not substitute for the raw Reality book or Reality platform fills. If the required raw-book interval is unavailable, any required interval is missing, or the issuer timestamp cannot be verified, mark the run INCOMPLETE.
